- Testimonial / Case Study Card: White background, 40px padding, no border, 8px radius on the outer card. Large pull-quote in telegraf 30px weight 300 at #101828, 1.33 line-height, with a...

## Guidance

## Guidance
- Do: Use Prismic Headings at 56px / 40px / 32px / 28px with -0.025em tracking for all section and display titles; never set headings above 56px or below 22px from this family.
- Do: Use 12px 24px padding and 8px radius for every button; never exceed 12px vertical padding or deviate from the 8px radius.
- Do: Pair the four pastel wash/cream pairs exactly: Lavender Wash (#e8c7ff) with Lavender Cream (#f5e6ff), Sky Wash (#c3eefe) with white, Peach Wash (#fcdac4) with Peach Cream (#fef1e9), Mint Wash (#d4f2e9) with Mint Cream (#e8f8f3). Do not cross-pair warm and cool pastels on the same card.
- Do: Keep the dark workshop band at #151515 with white floating cards; do not introduce gradients, patterns, or imagery inside the band — the contrast inversion is the visual statement.
- Do: Use Prismic Violet (#8e44ec) for developer-side accents and Prismic Blue (#59b5f8) for marketer-side accents; never use both chromatic colors on the same element.
- Do: Set body text at 18px with 1.56 line-height in long-form sections and 16px with 1.50 in dense contexts like nav, lists, and cards.
- Don't: Do not use Prismic Violet, Prismic Blue, or Prismic Green as filled button backgrounds — they are border-and-text accents only. Primary actions stay Graphite #151515.
- Don't: Do not introduce drop shadows on cards, buttons, or nav. Elevation must come from contrast inversion, pastel borders, or charcoal bands.
- Don't: Do not use more than one chromatic color per section. Pick violet OR blue OR green as the section's voice and let the others rest.
- Don't: Do not set type below 14px or above 56px. The Prismic Headings family stops at 56px display and the copy family stops at 14px caption.
- Don't: Do not use full-color photography in the hero or feature sections. Imagery must be isometric 3D illustration with 2px black outlines or grayscale wordmark logos.
- Don't: Do not round cards above 12px or below 12px. The 12px card radius is the single card language — do not mix in 16px or 8px cards.
